title: The Echoing Hall
text: A great hall of black marble where every word comes back changed. Speak, and the walls answer in your voice with something that is almost what you said, and almost true. Each Scion who speaks here hears something about themselves they did not know.

options.label: Each Scion speaks their name into the hall.

outcomes.text: The echo says your name the way someone who loved you said it.
The echo says your name the way your enemies will.

options.label: Each Scion keeps silent, and listens.

outcomes.text: You cross in silence, and hear everything the hall says about everyone else.
